svg.title: The idea: the machine opens the vault, only you with your passkey take full control
svg.desc: On the left, a running machine with a small square safe door in its lower front, shut, and a green open padlock on it. The label says Opens the vault so the platform can run. Three small app gears, each with a small green secret ticket above it, receive from the machine and run. The big gold round-headed key hangs beside the vault, labelled Unlock key. Two small padlocked copies hang on the machine, each with a teal square-headed key, a small gold key and a passkey badge. On the right, the label says Only you, with your passkey: full control. A tiny legend at the bottom shows a green open padlock, Vault open, and a red closed padlock, Vault closed. The admin confirms on a phone with a fingerprint; the phone carries a matching passkey badge. The admin also holds a cream envelope with a small gold key, the recovery package.
